A concurrent author commit can occur after currentHead returns and before tx.Commit, allowing a Verdict for the previously reviewed head to be recorded after the Member has moved. This violates the exact-head guarantee under normal concurrent use.","action":"Coordinate the head check and Verdict insertion with the repository/task head mutation protocol, such as acquiring the repository synchronization lock or otherwise revalidating under a lock that prevents commits from occurring between the final head check and commit.","rule":"","head":"30c149978cef41aa0bfd4274e26cb7e6bee0f35a"}]}
